title: Metaplane Error-Rate Trend Anomaly
app: Metaplane monitor results and incidents via the Metaplane API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=metaplane:monitor
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as events, sum(eval(status="alerting")) as errors by _time
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/events,2)
| eventstats avg(error_rate) as avg_rate, stdev(error_rate) as sd_rate
| where error_rate>avg_rate+3*sd_rate
| sort - _time
description: Baselines the hourly error rate for Metaplane and flags hours where it spikes more than three standard deviations above normal, catching emerging instability before it becomes an outage.
value: An error-rate spike is the earliest signal that Metaplane is degrading; statistical baselining suppresses routine noise and pages only on genuine anomalies.
implementation: Ingest Metaplane logs into index=bi; schedule every 15 minutes over a trailing window and alert on 3-sigma error-rate anomalies.
visualization: Timechart of Metaplane error rate with anomaly band.
grandmaExplanation: We learn what a normal amount of Metaplane errors looks like and warn you only when something is genuinely going wrong.
